    if b == 0:
        return a
    return gcd(b, a % b)

def go():
    test = sys.stdin.readline()
    if test is None or test.strip() == '':
        return
    
    tt = int(test.split()[0])
    n = tt
    
    # Read next line for array a
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    a = list(map(int, line.split()))
    # Read next line for array b
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    b = list(map(int, line.split()))
    
    alicemax = 0
    bobmax = 0
    
    if a[0] != 0:
        alicemax += min(a[0], b[1])
    if a[1] != 0:
        alicemax += min(a[1], b[2])
    if a[2] != 0:
        alicemax += min(a[2], b[0])
    
    if b[0] != 0:
        bobmax += min(b[0], a[1])
        b[0] -= min(b[0], a[1])
        if b[0] != 0:
            bobmax += min(b[0], a[0])
    
    if b[1] != 0:
        bobmax += min(b[1], a[2])
        b[1] -= min(b[1], a[2])
        if b[1] != 0:
            bobmax += min(b[1], a[1])
    
    if b[2] != 0:
        bobmax += min(b[2], a[0])
        b[2] -= min(b[2], a[0])
        if b[2] != 0:
            bobmax += min(b[2], a[2])
    
    print((n - bobmax), alicemax)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    go()
